messages:
maria.lopez: Heads-up: product is announcing v1 client deprecation. We need coordinated docs work: short migration guide, updated snippets (chat, streaming, embeddings), and a deprecation banner. Target merge date: 2026-04-15.

samir: Are we shipping any runtime compatibility layer in SDK 2.x?

maria.lopez: There will be a minimal compat shim for simple non-streaming calls (header & param mapping). No compat for streaming or function-calls 11 those must be explicit v2 examples.

kevin: Important: model name remap list. redwood-small -> rw/small-1, redwood-chat -> rw/chat-1, redwood-embed -> rw/emb-large. Also embeddings billing changed (now per 768-dim chunk). Call that out.

olivia: I'll draft the embeddings before/after snippet plus a one-line note about dims->billing.

	// v1 embeddings (old)
	// client.embeddings({ model: 'redwood-embed', input: ['one', 'two'] })

	// v2 embeddings (new)
	// const resp = await rwClient.embeddings.create({ model: 'rw/emb-large', input: ['one', 'two'] })
	// console.log(resp.data[0].embedding.length) // note dims -> billing units

samir: For chat, show call-signature change and header rename: X-Client -> X-RW-Client. Also mention token scoping is unchanged.

	// v1 chat
	// client.chat.create({ model: 'redwood-chat', messages: [...] })

	// v2 chat
	// const chat = await rwClient.chat.completions.create({ model: 'rw/chat-1', input: { messages: [...] } })

Note: Add a small "compat limitations" callout listing streaming, function-calls, and structured outputs as not covered by the shim.

taylor_w: I'll open a PR with TS/JS snippet swaps + header callout and a short migration note. Will include a streaming caveats section (no shim). ETA: EOD tomorrow.

maria.lopez: Tag me as reviewer. Keep PRs small (one thing per PR).

kevin: Also: fallback behavior changed. If a pinned model is unavailable we now return 409 with header x-rw-fallback instead of silently routing. Add troubleshooting bullet and sample retry code.

olivia: I'll write the 409 troubleshooting bullet and a tiny retry snippet.

samir: Do starter repos/quickstarts need updates? They still reference v1 CLI flags.

maria.lopez: Yes 1 update examples/starter and README templates. CLI change example:

	# v1
	rw-up --client v1 --model redwood-chat

	# v2
	rw-up --client v2 --model rw/chat-1

doc-bot: docs-bot: preview build will run once PRs open.

maria.lopez: Action items:
- taylor_w: PR with code snippet swaps + headers + migration note (owner)
- olivia: embeddings note + 409 troubleshooting bullet
- samir: compat callout text + limitations list
- kevin: model mapping table + fallback notice
- all: update starter examples used by templates

samir: Quick question 1 do we want a short changelog entry for SDK releases mentioning removed v1 helpers?

maria.lopez: Yes, small changelog line and link to migration guide.

kevin: I'll push the model map table to the PR branch and include a tiny JSON mapping file for reference.

taylor_w: Opening PR now and will ping reviewers. Thanks everyone.

maria.lopez: Once merged I'll update the deprecation banner with final dates and migration links. :thumbsup:
